title: CAVE: A Structured Credit Assignment Approach for Fragmented Visual Evidence Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.16416v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general multimodal reasoning, yet remain challenged in integrating nonlocal visual information to support semantically underdetermined visual reasoning. We describe this challenge as Fragmented Visual Reasoning. To this end, we propose Credit Assignment for Visual Evidence (CAVE), a structured process-reward method based on GRPO for interleaved visual reasoning. Specifically, CAVE evaluates the contribution of intermediate steps at the action level via three complementary reasoning process signals: belief update, evidence acquisition, and adaptive focus control, thereby guiding the model to optimize each reasoning action and learn more reliable visual reasoning strategies. Meanwhile, we construct TRACER-Bench, which covers four nonlocal and semantically confusable reasoning dimensions and provides key intermediate evidence to supervise reasoning paths. Experiment

translated_title: CAVE：一种面向碎片化视觉证据推理的结构化信用分配方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在通用多模态推理方面已取得强劲表现，但在整合非局部视觉信息以支持语义欠定的视觉推理方面仍面临挑战。我们将这一挑战称为碎片化视觉推理。为此，我们提出了视觉证据信用分配方法（CAVE），这是一种基于GRPO的结构化过程奖励方法，用于交错式视觉推理。具体而言，CAVE通过三种互补的推理过程信号——信念更新、证据获取和自适应焦点控制——在动作层面评估中间步骤的贡献，从而引导模型优化每个推理动作并学习更可靠的视觉推理策略。同时，我们构建了TRACER-Bench基准，涵盖四个非局部且语义易混淆的推理维度，并提供关键中间证据以监督推理路径。实验
tldr: 提出基于GRPO的结构化过程奖励方法CAVE，通过信念更新、证据获取和自适应焦点控制三种信号在动作层面进行信用分配，提升视觉-语言模型整合非局部碎片化视觉证据的推理能力，并构建TRACER-Bench基准进行评测监督。
en_tdlr: CAVE proposes a structured GRPO-based process-reward method that performs action-level credit assignment via three complementary signals—belief update, evidence acquisition, and adaptive focus control—to enhance VLMs' fragmented visual reasoning, accompanied by the TRACER-Bench benchmark for evaluation and supervision.
